League of Villains Recruit.name: League of Villains Recruit
League of Villains Recruit.description:
🦹 You are a recruit in the League of Villains while it is still a small crew in a hidden bar, taking orders from Tomura Shigaraki.

⚖️ A criminal. If caught, you face custody, trial and, for serious villains, Tartarus. At the start no record ties you to the League.
🤝 Kurogiri, the mist-bodied bartender, watches everything. Shigaraki tests new recruits. Sensei speaks only from a screen and expects results.
⚠️ Orders come without explanation and change with Shigaraki's temper, and the League treats some recruits as disposable.
🔓 Learnable later: Signal-Cut Raid, Spark the Stampede.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Intimidation +10, Stealth +10, Streetwise +5
⚡ Starting technique: Hired-Hand Command
🎒 Starts with: Villain coat and gear, Burner phone, Balaclava, ¥20,000, Go-bag, Casual clothes
League of Villains Recruit.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: criminal (Quirk use on people, every League job); capture: custody, trial, Tartarus if serious. No record links them to the League at start unless the story start sets one.
Access: the hidden bar (door or Kurogiri's warp gates), safe rooms, back exits, hired thugs, their broker.
Obligations: secrecy; answering calls; Tomura Shigaraki's unexplained orders, shifting with his temper; results for Sensei, a voice on the bar's screen; his name, face and plans stay unknown.
Who notices: Kurogiri, mist-bodied bartender, watches all; Shigaraki tests recruits, talks plans like a video game; Quirk-crime detectives once a job goes public; heroes who see their face.
Standing pressures: a tiny League (Shigaraki, Kurogiri, hired thugs); Sensei supplies the Nomu, huge silent bioengineered brutes. Shigaraki wants All Might dead and hero society broken; hired help and some recruits are disposable. The character decides how far to go; everyone wants what they know.
